- t: ወይቤ ፡ ድማትዮስ ፡ ዘአንጾኪያ ፡ እወ ፡ ይመስል ፡ እስከ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ሞቱ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ ወእምድኅረ ፡ ሞቱሰ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ እምባዕዳን ፡ ነቢያት ፡ ዘተጽሕፈ ፡ አምሳሉ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
- i: And Dematyos of Antioch said, “Yes, what was written seems true up to the day of Solomon’s death. But after his death, as for what was written, it is like it, from other prophets (?).” (The text ends with a row of nine ፨ signs.)
